_comment: Canonical registry of SPECIAL image formats — directory/archive shaped, or needing a non-default serving backend. Mirrored by Go (backend/controlplane/internal/httpapi/special_formats.go) and Python (backend/deepagents_runtime/src/ultra_deepagents/imaging/special_formats.py); a parity test in each language asserts its registry matches this file. TEMPLATE — to add a format: append one entry here, mirror it in both registries, and add the reader/serve hook.

formats.description: OME-NGFF (OME-Zarr) multiscale store. A directory; already a chunked multiscale pyramid. Served natively by the ngff-service (no transcode, no pyramid derivation).
